title: Add Built‑in Request Body Validation Middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight, schema‑based request body validator that integrates with existing routing. It automatically returns 400 with detailed error messages when payloads don't match the defined schema, improving security and developer ergonomics.
testCases: Should pass when request body matches the schema
Should reject with 400 and a descriptive error when required fields are missing
Should reject with 400 when field types are incorrect
Should allow optional fields to be omitted
Should work with async validation functions
acceptance: All new tests pass, existing test suite remains green, and validation middleware can be attached to any route via router.use or per‑route options without breaking current functionality.
reason: Ensures data integrity at the edge of the application, reduces boilerplate validation code, and prevents malformed input from reaching business logic, aligning with yantraverse's stability‑focused roadmap.
